abstract: Governmental information manipulation has been hard to measure and study systematically. This paper provides comparable country-level estimates of the extent of misinformation in official data, in a large and diverse set of countries. We hand-collect data from a variety of sources in 134 countries to estimate misreporting of Covid mortality in 2020-2021. We find that information manipulation by governments during this period was remarkably widespread: between 45%–55% of governments misreport the number of deaths. Misreporting is large in magnitude: together, the countries we study reported 5.08 million Covid deaths during 2020-2021, whereas actual Covid mortality was more than double, at 12.47 million. The lion’s share of misreporting cannot be attributed to a country’s capacity to accurately diagnose and report deaths. Contrary to some theoretical expectations, information manipulation takes the form of downplaying rather than exaggerating the severity of the crisis. What characterizes governments that manipulate information? We examine the role of macroeconomic incentives, culture, audience sophistication, and institutions. The evidence strongly suggests that misreporting is higher where governments face fewer social and institutional constraints; in countries holding elections during this period; and in countries with a communist legacy. abstract_zh: 政府信息操纵一直难以被系统性地衡量和研究。本文在大量且多样化的国家中，提供了关于官方数据中错误信息程度的可比国家层面估计。我们手工收集了134个国家多种来源的数据，以估算2020-2021年新冠死亡人数的误报情况。研究发现，在此期间政府的信息操纵行为异常普遍：45%至55%的政府误报了死亡人数。误报规模巨大：我们研究的国家在2020-2021年期间报告了508万新冠死亡病例，而实际新冠死亡率超过这一数字的两倍，达到1247万。绝大多数误报不能归因于国家准确诊断和报告死亡的能力。与某些理论预期相反，信息操纵表现为淡化而非夸大危机的严重性。那么，操纵信息的政府有何特征？我们考察了宏观经济激励、文化、受众成熟度以及制度的作用。证据强烈表明，在面临较少社会与制度约束的政府中、在选举期间的国家中、以及具有共产主义遗产的国家中，误报率更高。类似内容被其他人浏览。
title: Manipulation of information in times of crisis: evidence from Covid excess mortality
title_zh: 危机时期的信息操纵：来自新冠超额死亡率的证据

abstract: Unexpected shocks to the electricity supply can influence people’s decision to invest in renewable energy, particularly when these technologies serve as substitutes for backup power. This study investigates the impact of a large-scale power outage on subsequent photovoltaic (PV) installations and examines how households and firms evaluate the expected benefits of PV systems as an emergency power source. Using a doubly-robust difference-in-differences design, we exploit the 2018 Hokkaido Eastern Iburi Earthquake in Japan as a natural experiment to estimate the effect of the subsequent blackout on municipality-level PV installations. Our results show that the blackout significantly increased commercial PV installations but had no effect on residential installations. In particular, commercial PV capacity rose by 4.243 kW per 1000 people per half-year following the blackout. Additional analysis suggests that the intermittent nature of solar power may limit the reliability of residential PV systems during emergencies, especially under adverse weather conditions. These findings highlight the need to address intermittency to enhance the role of PV systems as resilient infrastructure.
journal: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
source_issue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management, Volume 138
title: Light after the darkness: Estimating the impact of power outages on subsequent solar installations
title_zh: 黑暗之后的光明：评估停电对后续太阳能安装的影响

abstract: We show that inequality can lead to social unrest in rural India. We develop a theoretical framework in which civilians rationally engage in social unrest to oppose the (unfair) distribution of surplus by the elite. Our model predicts that the likelihood of observing social unrest in a village increases with the sum of distances between the (log) average and the lowest incomes. We test this prediction using unique microdata on bank account information covering 2197 Indian villages. Guided by our theoretical framework, we propose an instrumental variable strategy based on the idea that positive water shocks disproportionately benefit the highest incomes in a village. Our analysis then shows that a 10% increase in our inequality measure leads to a 6.5% rise in the unconditional probability of social unrest in a given village and month.
abstract_zh: 我们证明，不平等可能导致印度农村的社会动荡。我们构建了一个理论框架，其中平民理性地参与社会动荡，以反对精英对剩余（不公平）的分配。我们的模型预测，村庄中出现社会动荡的可能性随（对数）平均收入与最低收入之间距离之和的增加而上升。我们利用覆盖2197个印度村庄的银行账户信息独特微观数据来检验这一预测。基于我们的理论框架，我们提出了一种工具变量策略，其依据是正向水资源冲击不成比例地惠及村庄中最高收入群体。我们的分析随后表明，我们衡量不平等指标的10%增长，会导致特定村庄在特定月份社会动荡的无条件概率上升6.5%。
title: Inequality and social unrest in India
title_zh: 印度不平等与社会动荡

abstract: Preferential trade agreement (PTA) membership is known to divert trade volumes away from nonmember (third) countries along the intensive margin of trade, yet much less is known about its effects on third-country market entry along the extensive margin of trade. This paper examines whether PTAs catalyze market entry into third countries, and more broadly whether PTAs create spillover effects beyond member countries that matter for development. Using bilateral trade data from 1948 to 2020, we employ a difference-in-differences strategy, and find that the third-country market entry rate rises by 2.1% when the origin country has a PTA partner in the destination region, even after accounting for prior regional export experience. This effect is comparable in magnitude to both the origin and destination countries joining the WTO. We further show that this effect is stronger when the destination and the origin’s PTA partners are more closely linked through deep integration, common language, and colonial ties, and when products are differentiated or regulation-intensive. Beyond these heterogeneity analyses, we shed light on the underlying mechanism by showing that preferential PTA provisions enhance regional market access. The resulting scale effect appears to be an important channel through which higher variable profits help exporters cover the costs of entering third-country markets. Overall, our findings highlight the quantitative importance of the third-country entry effect of PTAs in explaining trade growth and offer broader implications for choosing optimal PTA partners.
abstract_zh: 优惠贸易协定（PTA）成员资格已知会沿贸易的集约边际将贸易量从非成员国（第三国）转移出去，然而，其对第三国市场进入的扩展边际影响却鲜为人知。本文考察了PTA是否促进了对第三国的市场进入，以及更广泛地，PTA是否产生了超越成员国、对发展具有重要意义的溢出效应。利用1948年至2020年的双边贸易数据，我们采用双重差分策略，发现当原产国在目的地地区拥有PTA伙伴时，第三国市场进入率上升2.1%，即便在考虑了先前区域出口经验后亦是如此。这一效应在规模上与原产国和目的地国加入世界贸易组织（WTO）的效应相当。我们进一步表明，当目的地与原产国的PTA伙伴通过深度一体化、共同语言和殖民联系更为紧密，以及当产品为差异化或监管密集型时，这一效应更为显著。除这些异质性分析外，我们通过显示优惠性PTA条款增强区域市场准入来阐明其潜在机制。由此产生的规模效应似乎是较高可变利润帮助出口商覆盖进入第三国市场成本的重要渠道。总体而言，我们的发现强调了PTA第三国进入效应在解释贸易增长中的数量重要性，并为选择最优PTA伙伴提供了更广泛的启示。

title: Catalysts for third-country market entry: The role of preferential trade agreements

abstract: Machine learning methods in asset pricing are often criticized for their black box nature. We study this issue by predicting corporate bond returns using interpretable machine learning on a high-dimensional bond characteristics data set. We achieve state-of-the-art performance while maintaining an interpretable model structure, overcoming the accuracy–interpretability trade-off. The estimation uncovers nonlinear relationships and economically meaningful interactions in bond pricing, notably related to term structure and macroeconomic uncertainty. Subsample analysis reveals stronger sensitivities to these effects for small firms and long-maturity bonds. Finally, we demonstrate how interpretable models enhance transparency in portfolio construction by providing ex ante insights into portfolio composition.
title: Glass box machine learning and corporate bond returns
title_zh: 玻璃箱机器学习与公司债券收益

abstract: This paper studies a preference revelation game induced by the Efficiency-Adjusted Deferred Acceptance (EDA) mechanism in a priority-based allocation problem. The main findings are: (i) we show the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under EDA through a simple algorithm; (ii) the equilibrium outcome from the algorithm coincides with the outcome of the Top Trading Cycles mechanism; and (iii) the strategy profile found by the algorithm is also a strictly strong Nash equilibrium in the game induced by the Deferred Acceptance mechanism.
title: On the existence of a strong Nash equilibrium under the efficiency-adjusted deferred acceptance mechanism
title_zh: 效率调整延迟接受机制下强纳什均衡的存在性
